title: Carry-Forward of Recent Use into Extension Visits — Visit Referral Ledger Rule
content:
When an In-Group Specialist Referral, an HMO Specialist Referral, an Out-of-Network Referral or a Physical Therapy Episode Authorization (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) is extended, the carry-forward of the extension visits follows the referral's recent use, counting unit uses less the restorations that reverse them. The extension visits are counted from the carry-forward.

## Clauses

1. Where the net uses in the 3 months before the handling date are 3 or more and the most recent use is within the 30 days before the handling date, the carry-forward is those net uses.
2. Where the net uses in those 3 months are 1 or more but clause 1 does not hold, the carry-forward is half of the net uses, rounded up to a whole visit.
3. Otherwise the carry-forward is the type's extension units: 4 for the In-Group Specialist Referral, 3 for the HMO Specialist Referral, 2 for the Out-of-Network Referral and 8 for the Physical Therapy Episode Authorization.

## Terms

- **Net uses** are the units used on the referral's own unit ledger in the 3 months before the handling date, less the units restored on that ledger in those 3 months.
- **Most recent use** is the date of the latest unit use on the referral's ledger; it is within the 30 days before the handling date when it falls no more than 30 days before that date. A referral with no unit use has no recent use.

## Cases (hypothetical ledgers)

| Net uses in 3 months | Most recent use | Clause | Carry-forward |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 12 days before | 1 | 5 |
| 3 | 30 days before | 1 | 3 |
| 5 | 40 days before | 2 | half of 5, rounded up: 3 |
| 2 | 5 days before | 2 | 1 |
| 1 | 70 days before | 2 | half of 1, rounded up: 1 |
| 0 (4 used, 4 restored) | 20 days before | 3 | the type's extension units |
